purpose: Single canonical runtime contract for map selection, zone resolution, fusion, boundary handling, and Visual Analyzer consumers.

coarse_fallback.scope: coarse role/site affinity only; zone_id may remain null

fusion_decision_table.case: label and polygon same zone, both >= support
label >= accept; polygon missing or < support
polygon >= accept; label missing or < support
one source >= accept; other source in [support,accept) disagrees
fusion_decision_table.result: higher-confidence zone accepted with diagnostic source_disagreement_secondary

fusion_decision_table.case: label >= accept AND polygon >= accept AND zones disagree
fusion_decision_table.result: ambiguous; hold previous stable zone only if boundary policy allows, otherwise zone_id=null

fusion_decision_table.case: both < accept but same zone and both >= support

boundary_policy.state: ambiguous when point is within margin of shared boundary or multiple polygon candidates exist
boundary_policy.without_previous_zone: zone_id=null until one candidate persists beyond zone_transition_persistence_sec

map_selection: Use config/map_registry_v1.json. Unresolved map_id blocks zone-dependent event generation.
minimap_profile: Dynamic rotation/centered crop unsupported in MVP unless calibration recovers a stable full-map transform; otherwise calibration_required.

consumer_contract.resolver_output: ZoneResolution timeline only; resolver MUST NOT emit gameplay events.
consumer_contract.position_change: Visual minimap_spatial_tracker consumes stable ZoneResolution transitions.
consumer_contract.rotation: Visual minimap_spatial_tracker validates a topology path from an origin with non-empty site_affinity to a stable destination whose affinity is disjoint. Edges come only from topology_edges.
consumer_contract.team_entry: Visual team_entry_analyzer detects crossing into any zone listed by sites[].zone_ids and dwell threshold.
consumer_contract.topology_source_of_truth: topology_edges only; adjacency is derived at runtime and is not stored separately.

calibration_failure_behavior: zone_id=null, zone_confidence=0, calibration_status=failed; no zone-dependent gameplay event emitted.
missing_geometry_behavior: zone-dependent facts/events unavailable; never infer exact callout/exposure topology with VLM.
